title: SparseTripletMatrix
author: JG
description: add functions AddSparseTripletMatrix with parameters like AddToDenseMatrix; also add functions AddSubmatrix() and AddTransposedSubmatrix to add dense submatrices for ObjectFFRFreducedOrder
releaseNotes: ObjectFFRF gives its mass matrix as sparse triplets (8-20 times faster for meshes of some hundred to thousand nodes), with exu.special.solver.superElementSparseMassMatrix = False as fallback; MatrixContainer appends dense submatrices and triplet matrices with offsets; ComputeItem returns the mass matrix of bodies with sparse mass matrices.
